title: Localized equality of maps tested on prescribed good cylinders and path objects
statement: Let $\mathcal M$ be a model category with the conventions of [lem-coef-reedy-model-structure], and let $\gamma:\mathcal M\to\mathcal H$ be an ordinary localization at its weak equivalences $W$, with its universal property for functors and natural transformations; enlarge universes as needed. Let $A$ be cofibrant and $B$ fibrant. A good cylinder for $A$ is data $i_0,i_1:A\to I$, $c:I\to A$, with $ci_0=ci_1=1_A$, $c\in W$, and $(i_0,i_1):A\amalg A\to I$ a cofibration. A good path object for $B$ is data $s:B\to P$, $p_0,p_1:P\to B$, with $p_0s=p_1s=1_B$, $s\in W$, and $(p_0,p_1):P\to B\times B$ a fibration. For every chosen good cylinder $I$ for $A$ and every chosen good path object $P$ for $B$, and all $f,g:A\to B$, the following are equivalent: $\gamma(f)=\gamma(g)$; there is $H:I\to B$ with $Hi_0=f$ and $Hi_1=g$; there is $K:A\to P$ with $p_0K=f$ and $p_1K=g$.

mathlib_match.how: exact clause by clause. For equality iff the specified cylinder homotopy, compose LeftHomotopyRel.iff_map_eq (FundamentalLemma.lean:129-134) with LeftHomotopyRel.leftHomotopy in Mathlib/AlgebraicTopology/ModelCategory/Homotopy.lean:109-112, and forget a cylinder homotopy for the reverse implication. For the path clause use RightHomotopyRel.iff_map_eq (FundamentalLemma.lean:122-127) and RightHomotopyRel.rightHomotopy in Homotopy.lean:117-119, with the same definitional reverse implication. Hypotheses [IsCofibrant A] [IsFibrant B] are at FundamentalLemma.lean:65-67 and Homotopy.lean:100. Cylinder/PathObject and their IsGood fields agree with the inline definitions (Cylinder.lean:135-153; PathObject.lean:136-154).
